description: This source file defines the code-behind for the 'EditTheory' ASP.NET Web Forms page within the OnlineExamSystem project. It manages navigation between different pages, session state updates, and dynamically populates course selection dropdowns based on semester and year selections.

classes.name: EditTheory
classes.description: Partial class for the 'EditTheory' web page, handling UI events and course selection logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial load event for the page. Currently, it performs no actions.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Sets a session variable '_CRS' with the selected course text.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the 'LoginPage.aspx' page to log out.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester/year.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course dropdown based on semester/year selection.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Event handler placeholder for course selection changes (currently does nothing).
